sources.title: Shin-Etsu MicroSi, Inc. | LinkedIn
sources.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists Shin-Etsu MicroSi, Inc. as a Phoenix-headquartered chemical manufacturing company and U.S. subsidiary of Shin-Etsu Chemical. It describes R&D and manufacturing of materials for semiconductor and coating industries, with product lines including thermal interface materials, lithography, packaging, PBN, photomasks and pellicles, quartz wafers and substrates, vinyl resins, optical isolators, advanced packaging materials, and sensor materials.
